controller: Pebble ProcessPool; terminates only its evaluation worker and restarts it
reason: Unbounded offline attempt made no ordered progress for more than 30 minutes on large JSON; 120 seconds references the existing TypeScript worker budget
reuse: Same-rule same-input completed observations at or below 110 seconds; longer completed cases and every unrecorded file are evaluated with the declared deadline
unknown_outcomes: separate evaluation_timeout/evaluation_error; excluded from completed-only refusal matrix, included in total availability denominator
cold_model_initialization: pool initialization; not the same as online per-call cold startup
